# Vaelspire — Complete Dense AI Agent Context (llms-full.txt)

Platform: Vaelspire (by Neotales) — Open-Core Rust Identity & Authentication Platform.
Repos:
- https://github.com/neotales/vaelspire (branch: dev)
- https://github.com/neotales/vaelspire-site (branch: dev)

Licensing:
- Open-Core (`crates/`, `ui/`, `scripts/`, `deploy/`): MIT (`LICENSE`). 100% free core security (zero SSO tax).
- Enterprise (`enterprise/`): Proprietary (`LICENSE-ENTERPRISE`), isolated Cargo workspace (`enterprise/Cargo.toml`).

Toolchain & Standards:
- Rust 1.100, edition 2024, workspace resolver 3, `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, `clippy::pedantic`, `missing_docs`.
- Library crates NEVER log (return typed `Result<T, AuthError>`). Only the `vaelspire` binary configures `tracing`.
- Database adapters use `neotales-dbapi = "=0.0.0-alpha.0"` & `neotales-migration = "=0.0.0-alpha.0"` (never expose sqlx in public APIs).
- Visual theme: Warm obsidian (`#0c0a09`, `#1c1917`), dragon-ember crimson (`#dc2626`, `#ea580c`), molten amber-gold (`#d97706`, `#f59e0b`, `#fde68a`), emerald (`#10b981`), Neotales purple ONLY for `by Neotales` attribution.

---

## 1. MIT Open-Core Crates (`crates/`)

1. `vaelspire-core`: I/O-free domain types (`User`, `Session`, `ApiKey`, `AuditEvent`, `AuthError`, `AuthStore`) + `vaelspire_core::extensions::{EnterpriseFeature, LicenseLimits, LicenseStatus, LicenseGate, CommunityLicenseGate, AuditSink, NoopAuditSink, TelemetrySignal, TelemetrySink, NoopTelemetrySink, RegionPolicy, SingleRegionPolicy, ReplicationEvent, ReplicationHook, NoopReplicationHook}`.
2. `vaelspire-auth`: Argon2id + bcrypt auto-upgrade, keyed BLAKE3 digests, `Zeroizing` secret hygiene, TOTP MFA (AES-256-GCM), Passkeys/WebAuthn, API keys, email OTP/reset/verify, social/OIDC client, tenants/roles/groups, `SessionCache`.
3. `vaelspire-axum`: Axum `AuthRouter` with double-submit CSRF cookie (`neotales.csrf` -> `x-csrf-token`), origin allow-list, rate limiter, session cookies (`neotales.session`).
4. `vaelspire-email`: Async `Mailer` trait, `MemoryMailer`, `SmtpMailer`.
5. `vaelspire-store-sqlite`: Embedded SQLite adapter over `neotales-dbapi-sqlite` + migrations (`open(path)`).
6. `vaelspire-store-postgres`: PostgreSQL adapter over `neotales-dbapi-postgres` + migrations (same `conformance.rs` suite).
7. `vaelspire-verify`: Zero-DB stateless `EdDSA` (`Ed25519`) JWT & RFC 7517 JWKS verifier (`TokenVerifier`, `Jwks`, `Jwk`, `VerifiedClaims`, `Audience`, `VerifyError`).
8. `vaelspire-oidc`: OIDC 1.0 / OAuth 2.0 IdP (`OidcProvider`, `OidcProviderConfig`, `OidcClient`, `ClientKind`, rotating Ed25519 JWKS with RFC 7638 thumbprints, exact-URI Auth Code + PKCE `S256`, Refresh Token Rotation + family reuse revocation, NHI `client_credentials` with strict scope attenuation, UserInfo, Introspect, Revoke).
9. `vaelspire`: Single-binary `clap` CLI (`serve`, `migrate`, `keygen`, `admin bootstrap`) + Axum HTTP server + optional `--features embed-ui` static SvelteKit bundle (`ui/build/`).

---

## 2. Server CLI & Environment Variables

Commands:
- `vaelspire keygen` (prints 64-char hex 32-byte key)
- `vaelspire migrate --sqlite <path>`
- `vaelspire admin bootstrap --sqlite <path> --email <email> --password <pw>`
- `vaelspire serve --bind 127.0.0.1:8080 --sqlite <path> --issuer <url> --ui-mode <embedded|external|api-only>`

Key env vars:
- `VAELSPIRE_BIND`, `VAELSPIRE_SQLITE_PATH`, `VAELSPIRE_TENANT_NAME`, `VAELSPIRE_AUTH_KEY`
- `VAELSPIRE_ISSUER`, `VAELSPIRE_UI_MODE`, `VAELSPIRE_INSECURE_HTTP`, `VAELSPIRE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, `VAELSPIRE_TRUST_PROXY`
- `VAELSPIRE_API_KEY_PREFIX` (default `vsp`), `VAELSPIRE_FORWARD_AUTH_LOGIN_URL`

---

## 3. Complete HTTP Surface

System & Discovery:
- `GET /health` -> `200 { status: "ok", service: "vaelspire", edition: "core", version }`
- `GET /ready` -> `200 { status: "ready", store: "sqlite", tenant_id }` or `503`
- `GET /metrics` -> Prometheus 0.0.4 text (`vaelspire_http_requests_total`, `vaelspire_http_responses_total`, `vaelspire_forward_auth_total`)
- `GET /.well-known/vaelspire` -> server metadata, issuer, ui_mode, cookies, endpoint map
- `ANY /forward-auth` -> verifies session cookie OR `Authorization: Bearer` / `X-API-Key`; returns `200` + `X-Vaelspire-User-Id`, `X-Vaelspire-Tenant-Id`, `X-Vaelspire-Email`, `X-Vaelspire-Auth-Method`, `X-Vaelspire-Session-Id`/`X-Vaelspire-Api-Key-Id`, or `401`/`302`.

Auth & Account (mutating routes require CSRF cookie echoed in `x-csrf-token`):
- `POST /sign-up`, `POST /sign-in`, `POST /sign-out`
- `GET /session`, `GET /sessions`, `DELETE /sessions/{id}`
- `GET /api-keys`, `POST /api-keys`, `DELETE /api-keys/{id}`

OIDC 1.0 & SAML:
- `GET /.well-known/openid-configuration`
- `GET /.well-known/jwks.json`
- `GET /oauth2/authorize` (session cookie required; exact redirect_uri; PKCE `S256`)
- `POST /oauth2/token` (`authorization_code`, `refresh_token`, `client_credentials`)
- `GET /oauth2/userinfo` (`Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`)
- `POST /oauth2/introspect` (RFC 7662), `POST /oauth2/revoke` (RFC 7009)
- `GET /admin/oidc/clients`, `POST /admin/oidc/clients` (session cookie OR API key)
- `GET /saml/metadata` (`application/samlmetadata+xml`)

SCIM 2.0 (RFC 7644):
- `GET /scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig`
- `GET /scim/v2/Users`, `POST /scim/v2/Users` (session cookie OR API key)
- `GET /scim/v2/Users/{id}`, `DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{id}` (session cookie OR API key)

Embedded UI (`--features embed-ui` + `--ui-mode embedded`):
- `GET /` -> `307 /ui/`
- `GET /ui/`, `GET /ui/{*path}` -> static SvelteKit SPA (`/ui/login`, `/ui/register`, `/ui/consent`, `/ui/account`, `/ui/admin`)
- `--ui-mode external` or `api-only` -> `/ui/*` returns `404`.

---

## 4. Isolated Enterprise Crates (`enterprise/Cargo.toml`)

- `vaelspire-license`: Offline Ed25519 `.vlic` (`vlic1.<b64-json>.<b64-sig>`) `LicenseSigner`, `verify_vlic`, `Ed25519LicenseGate: LicenseGate`. Non-bricking invariant: `allows_login()` ALWAYS returns `true` even on `GracePeriod` or invalid signature.
- `vaelspire-worm`: `WormAuditSink: AuditSink` with SHA-256 hash-chaining (`ChainedAuditRecord`, `verify_chain`) + `build_archive` for `S3ObjectLock`, `AzureImmutableBlob`, `GcsBucketLock`.
- `vaelspire-telemetry`: `SiemTelemetrySink: TelemetrySink` bounded non-blocking queue with `ExportFormat::{OtlpJson, SplunkHecNdjson, DatadogLogsJson}` + `TelemetryStats`.
- `vaelspire-georep`: `ResidencyPolicy: RegionPolicy` (EU/US/APAC pinning + `check_local_write`) and `ReplicationLogHook: ReplicationHook` (`ReplicationEnvelope`, `read_since`).

---

## 5. Planned Architecture Milestones (Pre-v0.1.0 & M4–M4.5)

- **GDPR & Log Redaction:** Log `user_id` + masked email (`wf******@domain.com`, configurable `masked|id-only|full`), Right to Erasure preserving append-only `auth_audit` via pseudonymous `actor_id`, Right of Access JSON export, IP retention/truncation (`/24` IPv4, `/48` IPv6), expanded bounded-cardinality `/metrics`.
- **Sessions & Anomaly Detection:** Sliding (`session_idle_timeout` + throttled `session_refresh_window`) AND hard absolute (`session_absolute_timeout`) session expirations; explicit `--ip-source` + `--trusted-proxies`; per-IP password-spray, unseen device/IP, refresh-token reuse, and optional GeoLite2 impossible-travel alerts.
- **Passkeys, Per-App RBAC & Management CLI:** Wire `passkey` feature + `--rp-id`/`--rp-origin` into server & SvelteKit UI; nullable `app_id` on roles & permissions + `auth_role_permission` + `auth_group_role`; dual-mode (local DB & remote API) CLI for `user`, `org`, `client`, `role`, `perm`, `group`, `api-key`, `audit`, `status`.
- **Self-Service Org IdP & Directory Sync:** DNS-verified domains, per-org email policies (`allow_public`, `business_domains_only`, `verified_domains_only`), Home Realm Discovery, delegated org SSO portal (OIDC/SAML + test mode + break-glass admin), and SCIM 2.0 `/scim/v2/Groups`.
- **Cloudflare & Kubernetes:** `wasm32`-clean `vaelspire-core`/`vaelspire-verify`, Cloudflare D1 `AuthStore` (`vaelspire-store-d1`) + Workers edge runtime for low-cost serverless hosting, Cloudflare Containers for native static binary, plus official Helm chart & Kubernetes manifests.
